Resonance +90: Passive: +90 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Sonic Lore +13: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 13% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Evocation Focus +4: +4 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Enchantment Focus +4: +4 Equipment bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
